summary: PBDB provides the occurrence-level data a gap analysis needs (149,537 species-resolved vertebrate occurrences with age bounds), so apparent reappearances can be listed. No dataset found separates a true re-evolution from a surviving but unsampled lineage (no Lazarus-taxon compilation found on Dryad, DataCite or Zenodo), and species names themselves are taxonomic decisions.
next_step: Query PBDB occurrences per species, flag species with gaps longer than a pre-registered threshold, then audit each flagged case against the cited literature.
obstacles_confirmed: Species names in PBDB are applied by taxonomists, so temporally separated homeomorphs may already be named as different species.
No ready-made Lazarus taxon table located.
